To determine how many days before the deadline Mike will finish his reading, we can follow these steps:

1. **Calculate the total days needed to read the book:** 
   Mike needs to read 200 pages at a rate of 10 pages per day. 
   $$\text{Days needed} = \frac{200 \text{ pages}}{10 \text{ pages/day}} = 20 \text{ days}$$

2. **Calculate how many days before the deadline he finishes:** 
   The deadline is 30 days, and Mike finishes reading in 20 days. 
   $$\text{Days before deadline} = 30 \text{ days} - 20 \text{ days} = 10 \text{ days}$$

Final answer: 10
